messages.content: What is the current Gini Coefficient of USA?

message.content:
The most recent estimates put the United States’ Gini coefficient at roughly **0.41** (or 41 %).  

| Source | Year | Gini |
|--------|------|------|
| OECD (Income inequality) | 2021 | 0.41 |
| World Bank (World Development Indicators) | 2022 | 0.421 |

These figures are based on household income data and are the latest publicly available values. If you need the exact methodology or the raw data tables, let me know!
